resolved_conflicts.explanation: FireLookout.com and WillhiteWeb say destroyed in 1960; the FFLOS register says removed in 1960 or later. The sources were not reconciled, so the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Fate is disputed (1960 destroyed vs removed in 1960 or later); the story keeps both. The 1956 staffing and fire items come from a Port Angeles Evening News item quoted on washingtonlookouts.weebly.com, under a Hurricane Ridge (hill) heading, so the lookout is identified by name only. The built date is 'early 1930s' with no exact year. No source we read describes the summit today beyond the public trail and the 2001 footing caption. The brief's access 'unknown' is now public (NPS trail).
